camel_example: aliyun fnf StopExecution --region cn-hangzhou --ExecutionName my_exec_name --FlowName my_flow_name
description_en: Stops an execution that is in progress in a flow
description_zh: 停止一个正在执行的流程
kebab_example: aliyun fnf stop-execution --flow-name my_flow_name --execution-name my_exec_name --region cn-hangzhou
name: StopExecution

parameters.help_en: The name of the workflow to be stopped. You can call the ListFlows operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 需要停止的流程名称，可以通过ListFlows的返回值获取
parameters.name: flow_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the execution to be stopped. You can call the ListExecutions operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 需要停止的执行名称，可以通过ListExecutions的返回值获取
parameters.name: execution_name

parameters.help_en: The reason for stopping the execution. The value must be 1 to 4,096 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 停止错误原因。长度为1~4096个字符
parameters.name: cause

parameters.help_en: The error code for stopping the execution. The error code must be 1 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 停止错误代码。长度为1~128个字符
parameters.name: error

FlowDefinition.example:
Legacy version:
"type: flow
version: v1
name: my_flow_name
steps:
 - type: pass
 name: mypass"

New version:
"Type: StateMachine
SpecVersion: v1
Name: my_flow_name
StartAt: my_state
States:
 - Type: Pass
 Name: my_state
 End: true"

Input.description_en: The input of the execution, which is in the JSON format
Input.description_zh: 执行的输入，为JSON对象格式

Output.description_en: The execution result, which is in the JSON format
Output.description_zh: 执行的输出，为JSON对象格式

RoleArn.description_en:
The Alibaba Cloud resource name (ARN) of the role that executed the flow. If the RoleArn in the flow definition is changed during the execution of the flow, the system records and returns a snapshot of the original RoleArn.

If you do not specify the RoleArn parameter in the request parameters, the response parameters do not contain the RoleArn parameter
RoleArn.description_zh:
执行的角色权限配置。若流程定义中的RoleArn在执行期间发生变更，系统将记录并返回执行初始时刻的RoleArn的快照。
如果您的流程在执行时未配置执行角色，则该字段不会出现

StartedTime.description_en: The time when the execution started

Status.description_en:
The execution status. Valid values:

Starting
Running
Stopped
Succeeded
Failed
TimedOut
Status.description_zh:
执行状态。取值说明如下：
Starting
Running
Stopped
Succeeded
Failed
TimedOut

StoppedTime.description_en: The time when the execution stopped
